title: The hidden psychology behind viral TikTok sounds

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Hey, did you know some TikTok sounds make you feel like you’re part of a secret club?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s not just fun — it’s how brands are now targeting your brain’s reward system.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Viral sounds use specific frequencies that trigger dopamine spikes in your brain.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The sound “Renegade” hit 2 billion views because it mirrors the rhythm of human speech.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects how you spend money, what you buy, and even how you feel about yourself.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? Your brain is being hacked — but you can learn to spot it.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What’s one sound that’s been stuck in your head all week?
